item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 04/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be persistently cool in the morning over the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Sunday. It will be cloudier over the region in the following couple of days.
